items.front: Kharif vs Rabi crops?
items.back: Kharif (monsoon): rice, cotton, bajra, maize; Rabi (winter): wheat, gram, mustard.
items.source: notes

items.front: Cotton's ideal soil and belt?
items.back: Black/regur soil; Gujarat, Maharashtra, Telangana.
items.examPoint: Fibre & cash crops — cotton, jute, sugarcane leading states
items.source: notes

items.front: India's iron-ore belts?
items.back: Odisha, Jharkhand (Singhbhum), Chhattisgarh (Bailadila), Karnataka (Bellary).
items.examPoint: Iron ore & ferrous minerals (manganese, chromite) — states & mines
items.source: notes

items.front: Gondwana vs Tertiary coal?
items.back: Gondwana ~98% bituminous (Damodar/Godavari); Tertiary lignite (Neyveli).
items.examPoint: Coal types — Gondwana (bituminous) vs Tertiary (lignite, Neyveli)
items.source: notes

items.front: Barytes — largest deposit in India?
items.back: Mangampet (Kadapa, AP) — world's single largest barytes deposit.
items.examPoint: Non-ferrous & non-metallic minerals — bauxite, copper, mica, limestone, barytes (AP)
items.source: notes

items.front: Where do the great fishing grounds occur?
items.back: Where warm & cold currents meet, over broad shelves, in upwelling zones.
items.examPoint: World fishing grounds — warm/cold current meeting, continental shelves, upwelling
items.source: notes

items.front: Weber's industrial location — iron & steel vs cotton textiles?
items.back: Iron & steel raw-material oriented (Chhota Nagpur); cotton textiles market/labour oriented.
items.examPoint: Industrial location theory — Weber least-cost, raw-material vs market orientation
items.source: notes

items.front: Largest container port vs largest by volume?
items.back: JNPT/Nhava Sheva largest container; Mundra largest by volume (private).
items.examPoint: Ports & inland waterways — 13 major ports, NW-1 to NW-5, Sagarmala
items.source: notes

items.front: AP's 'Rice Bowl' and chillies hub?
items.back: Krishna-Godavari delta = Rice Bowl; Guntur = chillies; Singareni = coal.
items.examPoint: AP economic geography — ports (Vizag/Krishnapatnam/Gangavaram), VCIC, aquaculture, deltaic agriculture
items.source: notes

items.front: Why is neem-coated urea promoted?
items.back: It slows urea dissolution in soil, raising nitrogen-use efficiency.
items.source: notes

items.front: Uses of maize?
items.back: Starch, biodiesel feedstock and alcoholic beverages.
items.source: notes

items.front: AP's new railway zone (2026)?
items.back: South Coast Railway — 18th zone, HQ Visakhapatnam.
items.examPoint: AP infrastructure 2026 — South Coast Railway (18th zone, HQ Visakhapatnam, operational 1 Jun 2026); greenfield ports (Ramayapatnam, Mulapeta, Machilipatnam, Kakinada SEZ); Bhogapuram airport
items.source: notes

items.front: Critical minerals in the news?
items.back: Lithium (Reasi J&K), rare earths, cobalt — Critical Minerals Mission 2025.
items.examPoint: World mineral & energy producers — iron (Australia), copper (Chile), gold, diamonds, coal (China), oil, uranium (Kazakhstan)
items.source: notes
